Built for the Pharmacy Industry Award 2020
From filling a shift to keeping your team in the loop. Make room for a more organised working day.
Drag-and-drop weekly rosters across multiple stores, with recurring templates and automatic conflict
Staff set availability windows and blackout dates, request leave, and managers approve in one tap.
Post once. Reach the right people.
Broadcast a shift through five priority tiers, from your own team out to the public board.
One-click PDF invoices built on Pharmacy Industry Award 2020 rates, with GST and ABN details.

Two-sided verified ratings, QR-code onboarding and ABN-verified pharmacy claiming.

widens the search only when you still need cover.

needed. Filling a shift is never guaranteed.

svg.text: ChemistTasker is a business operations and workforce management platform. It does not provide medical advice, patient care services, medication
management or access to patient health records. All clinical decisions remain the responsibility of licensed healthcare professionals.
